mapper.select: select o.id as id, o.operate_emp_id as operateEmpId, o.operate_time as operateTime, o.class_name as className, o.method_name as methodName, o.method_params as methodParams, o.return_value as returnValue, o.cost_time as costTime, e.name as operateEmpName from operate_log o left join emp e on e.id = o.operate_emp_id
mapper.insert: insert into operate_log (operate_emp_id, operate_time, class_name, method_name, method_params, return_value, cost_time) values (#{operateLogInfo.operateEmpId}, #{operateLogInfo.operateTime}, #{operateLogInfo.className}, #{operateLogInfo.methodName}, #{operateLogInfo.methodParams}, #{operateLogInfo.returnValue}, #{operateLogInfo.costTime})
